headline: Reggie takes things to another level after getting his hands on Tylil’s prized possession
body: Reggie takes things to another level after getting his hands on Tylil’s prized possession — a painting featuring LeBron James — only for the situation to take a shocking turn when Reggie ends up destroying it. What makes the situation even crazier is that Reggie was actually able to acquire the painting from someone, making the decision to destroy it even more unexpected. What was supposed to be a prized piece of memorabilia has now turned into a moment nobody saw coming.
